passages: The Central Library is situated in the main academic block of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amaravati Campus and operates from 6:30 AM to 9:00 PM on weekdays and holidays.
Students can email helpdesk@av.amrita.edu or call extension 5001 for any Wi-Fi or IT-related support. The ICTS department assists with all network and connectivity issues.
The gym operates from 5:45 AM–8:15 AM and 5:00 PM–8:15 PM, while playfields are open from 6:00 AM–7:00 PM on working days and extended hours during holidays.
Students can visit the intranet portal under the “Timetables & Calendars” section to download the latest academic schedules for their program and year.
All student-related concerns should be directed to the Student Affairs office, headed by Mrs. Sujatha, or the Student Council representatives.
Library membership forms can be obtained at the library counter or downloaded from the intranet at https://intranet.av.amrita.edu/resources/library.
Send a request to sysadmin@av.amrita.edu or visit the ICTS department for assistance with your Amrita email or Microsoft 365 login credentials.
All Amrita Amaravati buses leave the campus at 5:00 PM sharp and start from their respective city boarding points at 7:00 AM.
The Department of Physical Education, headed by Dr. Kavitha Mutyala, manages all sports activities and training sessions on campus.
Each student is allocated 6 Mbps Wi-Fi bandwidth. For special academic needs, students can request higher bandwidth from ICTS one day in advance.
The library provides access to e-books and journals through the digital library portal and DELNET discovery services. Login details are available at the library.
As per the academic calendar 2025–26, MBA first-year Trimester I classes commence on June 28th following the orientation program.
Students can submit a Book Recommendation Form via the library’s intranet page. Approved requests are processed by the library procurement team.
Students can contact the ICTS helpdesk by emailing helpdesk@av.amrita.edu or visiting the ICTS office located near the academic block.
The campus offers indoor sports such as badminton, table tennis, chess, and carrom in the sports complex under supervision of physical instructors.
Timetables for all programs are published on the intranet at https://intranet.av.amrita.edu under “Timetables & Calendars.”
The Student Council is headed by elected student representatives, and the Student Affairs department is managed by Mrs. Sujatha.
The plagiarism check form is available on the library intranet under “Library Forms.” Students must submit it signed by their research supervisor and HOD.
Students can access campus resources via https://intranet.av.amrita.edu using their Amrita credentials.
Book issue and return services are available Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
Faculty may contact Lab Administrators via computerlabs@av.amrita.edu to request lab access for exams, workshops, or research activities.
Students can register using the NDLI passkey available on the library portal to access the National Digital Library of India services.
Event organizers can email helpdesk@av.amrita.edu to request audiovisual setup for seminars, workshops, or cultural events.
The Amaravati campus offers cricket, football, volleyball, basketball, and a 200m athletic track for outdoor activities.
All exam timetables and notifications are uploaded to the intranet under the “Exam Cell” or “Timetables” section.
Student Affairs is managed by Mrs. Sujatha and operates under the Student Council to address student well-being and campus engagement.
DELNET resources can be accessed via the library intranet page. Username and password are available at the circulation desk.
Students facing CMS issues should email cmshelp@av.amrita.edu for assistance with course access or submission errors.
During holidays, the gym is open from 6:00 AM–9:00 AM and yoga sessions are conducted between 7:00 AM–8:00 AM.
Academic holidays are listed in the intranet calendar and periodically announced via the E-Notice Board on https://intranet.av.amrita.edu.
The Physical Education Department coordinates inter-campus tournaments for cricket, athletics, and other sports.
The ICTS office is open on all working days from 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM for IT support, maintenance, and ticket logging.
Books can be renewed twice through the library counter or by emailing library@av.amrita.edu if not reserved by another user.
Orientation schedules are published by Student Affairs and Student Council on the intranet before the semester begins.
Bus routes, timings, and boarding points are listed under the Transport section on the intranet and displayed at main notice boards.
Submit a request to ICTS via helpdesk@av.amrita.edu one day prior to the requirement specifying your project details.
The ICTS department maintains and monitors the campus surveillance systems installed at key locations like gates and hostels.
Event details and schedules are regularly updated on the intranet’s E-Notice Board and sent via student mailers.
Email credentials are issued automatically upon admission and sent to your registered mobile and email by ICTS.
The Annual Sports Day is held once every academic year, coordinated by the Physical Education Department.
Research scholars can submit the plagiarism form signed by their supervisor and HOD at the library desk or email a_muthuraj@av.amrita.edu.
The department includes Dr. Kavitha Mutyala (Head), Mr. B.S. Murali Krishna, and Mr. S.A. Sreedev as instructors.
The new arrivals section is displayed near the issue counter and also listed online in the library’s intranet page.
Connect to the “AmritaNet” Wi-Fi SSID and log in with your Amrita credentials provided by ICTS.
The Student Council coordinates Republic Day and Independence Day events under guidance from Student Affairs.
Exam forms are released online on the intranet under “Exam Notifications.” Students are alerted via email announcements.
The full list of library rules is available on the intranet under “Library Rules & Regulations.”
For AUMS course registration issues, students should contact their class advisor and CC Student Affairs (Mrs. Sujatha).
Send an event booking request to helpdesk@av.amrita.edu for AV setup and approval from Student Affairs.
Mid-term and end-term trimester exams are conducted as per the academic calendar published each term.
Cricket practice nets are located behind the sports ground and can be booked through the Physical Education Department.
Students can enroll in clubs via Student Affairs or register through club forms posted on the intranet.
The library operates Monday–Saturday, with limited hours on Sundays and holidays.
The Systems Administration Group under ICTS manages all central servers and data centre operations.
Faculty publications are available in the Amrita Repository and can be searched via the library intranet page.
Hostel allocations are coordinated by Student Affairs with verification from the Hostel Office.
Official holidays are listed in the academic calendar available on the intranet’s Calendar section.
The campus gyms are equipped with treadmills, ellipticals, and multi-gym stations for strength and cardio training.
Contact details of all Student Council representatives are listed in the Student Council section on the intranet.
Students can submit an online Inter Library Loan request via the library intranet page for unavailable materials.
The list of bus routes and boarding points for Guntur and Vijayawada is available under the Transport tab on the intranet.
Cultural and tech fests like Advika and Prachurya are held annually under the supervision of Student Affairs and Student Council.
All circulars and notices are available digitally on the E-Notice Board within the intranet portal.
Lost ID cards should be reported to Student Affairs immediately for reissue.
Reference books can be borrowed overnight with Librarian approval and must be returned by the next day.
If a network or AUMS issue occurs, take a screenshot and email dycoe_com@av.amrita.edu with details.
The Academic Cell updates and uploads all timetables each semester under the Calendar section of the intranet.
The gym operates from 6:00 AM–9:00 AM on holidays and special schedules are posted on the intranet.
Library memberships are renewed every semester at the circulation counter. Students can also renew online through the intranet portal under “Library Services.”
For urgent IT issues such as system failures or connectivity problems, contact ICTS at helpdesk@av.amrita.edu or visit the ICTS office during working hours.
Yoga and meditation sessions are conducted under expert instructors in the sports complex each morning and evening for all students.
The full academic calendar is available on the intranet under the “Timetables & Calendars” section with downloadable PDF versions for each program.
All student discipline and welfare activities are managed by the Student Affairs Department under the leadership of Mrs. Sujatha.
Discussion and reading rooms can be reserved by visiting the library front desk or emailing library@av.amrita.edu at least one day in advance.
Students should email helpdesk@av.amrita.edu describing the issue or contact extension 5001 to log a ticket with ICTS.
The Physical Education Department organizes all intramural competitions and talent searches for students every semester.
Exam dates for all B.Tech programs are listed in the intranet under “Exam Notifications” within the Academic section.
All student events must be approved by the Student Council and Student Affairs before scheduling or promotion.
The library provides question banks through the intranet under “Library Services.” Students can also request printed copies at the counter.
If email access fails, contact sysadmin@av.amrita.edu with your roll number and issue details for immediate assistance.
The main playground with a 200m track, basketball, volleyball, and cricket nets is located beside the central block.
If timetable discrepancies occur, students should report to their department coordinator or check the updated version on the intranet.
Student grievances should be submitted to Student Affairs or the Student Council grievance committee for resolution.
Students can access e-books, journals, databases, and DELNET resources through the library’s digital portal on the intranet.
Students requiring specific software or hardware setup for projects must email helpdesk@av.amrita.edu at least 24 hours in advance.
Indoor sports include chess, table tennis, carroms, and badminton in the indoor hall near the hostel blocks.
The official list of academic holidays is published on the intranet under the Academic Calendar each June.
Student Affairs collaborates with the Student Council to help students plan and execute campus-wide events.
